description: This file declares the HeartbeatProcedure class and its factory, which are responsible for managing heartbeat procedures in the Rialto server component. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal handling for heartbeat messages and their lifecycle.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedureFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating HeartbeatProcedure instances, implementing the IHeartbeatProcedureFactory interface.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Implements the heartbeat logic, managing ping sending and response handling, and creating heartbeat handlers.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler
classes.description: Internal class handling individual heartbeat events, such as ping sent and error states.

methods.name: createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatProcedure instance with the specified acknowledgment sender and ping ID.

methods.name: createHandler
methods.description: Creates a new heartbeat handler for a specific control ID.

methods.name: pingSent
methods.description: Indicates that a ping has been sent.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles an error event in the heartbeat process.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the heartbeat.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts the heartbeat process for a given control ID.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Completes the heartbeat process, recording success or failure.
